description: One public JokeStack event: date and time, venue and address, kind, length, languages, organizer and description. Takes an id or link from jokestack_search_events. Signing up happens on the event's page, which the link opens.

event.description: The event's id, or its JokeStack link.

language.description: Language for city names and links: 'pl' for jokestack.pl, 'en' for the English site. Defaults to the site that was called.
